text: In accordance with Section 9.A. of the Consolidated Rules of Procedure for the Property Standards Committee, as amended, each Panel shall adopt a schedule of meetings to hear appeals for each year. The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel's meetings will be held remotely until further notice.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Adopted the following meeting dates for 2021, as set out in the letter (June 15, 2021) from the Committee Secretary, Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: a. Tuesday, September 21, 2021 at 9:30 a.m.; b. Tuesday, October 26, 2021 at 9:30 a.m.; c. Tuesday, November 30, 2021 at 9:30 a.m.; and d. Tuesday, December 14, 2021 at 9:30 a.m.
